name: bharosa
description: Typed Bharosa resource SDK with server credentials or caller-owned transport. Local development package; not published.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Publication disabled pending owner release approval')"
scripts.typecheck: node tooling/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node tooling/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node tooling/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --typeRoots tooling/node_modules/@types test/api-compatibility.ts
